verdict.rationale: Deleting a connection is a fair question for an open-finance aggregator like Belvo, so the axis applies. But nothing in the evidence pack documents deleting a link or user, stopping recurring collection, or purging held data. The links material covers only creation, external_id and weekly refresh, so absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can sever and clean up — a documented way to delete a connection or user and have the platform stop collecting and purge held data
